entries.text: Newcomers landed: 8 Munoha came ashore from elsewhere.
The Munoha are the island's first hunters.
Hard times for the Maleha: only 28 are left of 58.
The last Munoha died; the species lived here 22 days.
Among the Malesha, a group grew apart: the Malega.
The Devuga multiply: 30 now, 9 a month ago.
The Malera are thriving: from 15 to 44 in 30 days.
